channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Monte Morris | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Monte Morris from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Monte Morris
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Mason Plumlee on reconnecting with his former Nuggets teammate Monte Morris:

“Monte is such an underrated player. I have so much respect for him….Ididn’t know that he was coming here, but I’m thrilled that he signed with the Suns”

Mason Plumlee on Monte Morris, Jul 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Chris Finch on Monte Morris
item.description:
Chris Finch on what excites him about the acquisition of Monte Morris:

“He's a winner. He just kind of makes the right play. Super solid, low turnover guy. He's used to playing off of a lot of star players really well. I think it's a fairly seamless partnership with Mike. It's not like this other type of guard that you have to adjust to. Just his high basketball IQ, you can't have enough of those guys. I didn't cross paths with him in Denver. I had left the season before he came. But I've heard nothing but amazing things. I was able to talk to him, just really excited to have him.”

Chris Finch on Monte Morris, Feb 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Monty Williams on Monte Morris, Cade Cunningham
item.description:
Monty Williams on Cade Cunningham/Monte Morris duo:

“I think anytime you have a guard like Tae that can get off the ball, shoot but can play PNR like he did the other day, I think it helps Cade not have to handle the ball as much. It's something we have to explore to see what we can do with it.”

Monty Williams on Monte Morris, Cade Cunningham, Jan 26, 2024. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Monty Williams on Monte Morris
item.description:
Monty on Monte Morris' debut:

“Just knows how to play. He has his own pace. You see what he was getting in the pick and roll … his poise and experience is something we definitely need.”

Monty Williams on Monte Morris, Jan 24, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris, Klay Thompson
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Klay Thompson:

“His defense is really good. ... He can guard anyone from Monte Morris to Aaron Gordon.... He's made some big plays for us besides just hitting shots.”

Steve Kerr on Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris, Klay Thompson, Apr 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Will Barton, Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris
item.description:
Not only is he on track to become the first player in league history to average at least 25 points, 13 rebounds and six assists per game, but also he’s making his teammates better along the way.

“I think the beauty of basketball is there is always someone who is going to step up — Monte (Morris), AG (Aaron Gordon), Will Barton,”

Nikola Jokic on Will Barton, Aaron Gordon, Monte Morris, Feb 28, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Michael Malone on Monte Morris
item.description:
Michael Singer:Michael Malone on Monte Morris:

“I don’t know for sure ... me, personally, I don’t think he’s going to be back for a little while.”

Michael Malone on Monte Morris, Apr 19, 2021. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Will Barton, Monte Morris, Sue Bird
item.description:
#Nuggets POBO, Tim Connelly, on Bird:

“We're always trying to find unique perspectives. ...It was really neat when she came to a few of our practices. Will Barton came to her and said 'Legend.' Monte Morris exchanged info to get her thoughts on how to play the PG position.”

Tim Connelly on Will Barton, Monte Morris, Sue Bird, Nov 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @chrisadempsey.
